data.cultural_impact: The name Vanu carries a profound cultural significance in Hinduism. It is a name deeply rooted in the Indian tradition of learning and knowledge. The name Vanu evokes images of Saraswati, the goddess of music, arts, wisdom, and learning. In Hindu mythology, Saraswati is often depicted as holding a veena (a musical instrument) and a book in her hands, symbolizing the union of knowledge and creativity. The name Vanu reflects the importance placed on education and scholarship in Hindu culture.
